name: Honami Yousuke
source:
Kinpou Institutute Senior High School 2nd Year.
Star Sign: Pisces
He has a Japanese father and an English mother.
He belongs to the tennis club and plays doubles with Akiyama.
He's quick-witted and is good at guessing other people's intentions, the genius type.
